text:
The plate is about 26 cm across. It holds 6 fries and one small meat patty, roughly 6x4 cm and perhaps 1.5 cm thick.

The fries are thin, about 7-9 cm long. At roughly 6-8 g each, 6 fries come to about 40 g, or around 130 kcal.

The patty is about 6 cm x 3.5 cm x 1.2 cm, which is about 25 cm³. That is roughly 25-30 g, or about 70 kcal.

Together that is about 70 g and about 200 kcal.
